title: Hearty Crunchy Mexican Corn Elote
description: A nutty and crunchy Mexican dish featuring whole milk and bonito shave, perfect for a date night, this ovo-vegetarian-friendly elote is a delicious and satisfying meal.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
Grill the corn on the cob for 10-12 minutes, turning every 2 minutes, until lightly charred.
In a large bowl, whisk together the whole milk, mayonnaise, chili powder, lime juice, salt, pepper, and paprika.
Once the corn is cool enough to handle, brush the milk mixture onto each ear of corn, making sure to coat all surfaces.
Sprinkle the shaved bonito flakes and crumbled cotija cheese over the corn.
Serve the elote hot, garnished with additional bonito flakes and cotija cheese if desired.
Offer lime wedges on the side for added flavor.
This dish is best served immediately, but it can be refrigerated for up to 24 hours and reheated before serving.
